text:
The abstract describes using a multivariable integrated evaluation method to assess performance and interdependency of CMIP6 GCMs, ranking them, and clustering based on similarity of multivariate error fields. While this aligns with the general idea of quantitatively evaluating models across key large‑scale driving fields, the candidate hypothesis introduces specific elements—such as a “Vector Field Evaluation (VFE) diagram” and particular metrics (RMSE, correlation coefficients, amplitude‑pattern similarity indices)—that are not mentioned in the abstract. Because the evidence does not explicitly support these added methodological details, the candidate hypothesis is not the main hypothesis supported by the study.

VERDICT: REJECT
